name: How long does it take to install or modify a sink for knee clearance?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to install or modify a sink for knee clearance?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a knee clearance modification or installation project depends on its scope. A straightforward installation of a new wall-mounted sink designed for clearance might take a day or two. However, if the project involves significant plumbing rerouting, demolition of existing cabinetry, countertop replacement, or structural adjustments, it could extend to several days or even a week. Factors like permit requirements and material lead times can also influence the overall timeline. Our team provides an estimated project schedule after an initial assessment.
acceptedAnswer.description: Installation or modification time varies; a new accessible sink might take 1-2 days, while extensive renovations with plumbing rerouting or demolition could take several days to a week. Permitting and material availability also affect the timeline.
